svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 9 (CUMULATIVE R489) · REUSABLE ARTIFACT CATALOG & FRESH-JUDGE UI POLISH
ADP v2.1.1 (Part-Hash Catalog) + designloop (Fresh-Judge Loop) + suzhe-ui + pi-emphasis (★243)
1. fblgit/artifacts-done-properly v2.1.1 (★42 · Apache-2.0)
• Part-Addressed Content-Hashed Artifact Catalog (141 Base Kits)
Every block has a stable part ID (e.g., triage.keys-table) & content hash
4 road skills (new, edit, adopt, catalog) + read/hold/publish/record via adp.py
2. suzhe-ai/suzhe-ui v1.0.0 (★20 · Apache-2.0 · EN/ZH/JA/KO)
• Commerce Register: white / #f5f5f7 / black alternating + single #0071e3 accent
• Editorial Register: warm paper #faf9f5 / #141413 + ink buttons + thin borders
• 1 signature visual per page, 1-sentence hints & device-tier effect degradation
• Eliminates generic AI purple-gradient slop on the very first generation pass
3. mubarakmarafa/designloop (★22 · Fresh-Judge Loop · MIT)
• Capture ➔ Fresh-Judge ➔ Implementer Loop (5.0 ➔ 6.75 ➔ 8.5 ➔ 9.15)
Judges never implement; implementers never judge; fresh judges spawned every round
3 modes: Professional polish, Art direction (Figma), Writing (cold-reader agent)
4. johnlindquist/pi-emphasis (★243 · 7 forks · Pi 1.5+ · MIT)
• Turns [[Done]], [[Failed]], [[Needs you]] into colored Nerd-Font status pills
• Pure presentation layer: stored transcripts, copies & HTML exports stay untouched
• Calls zero models and costs $0 to run across Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, iTerm2 & VS Code
• Instant visual scanning for multi-agent build and deployment pipelines
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R9-ADP-DESIGNLOOP-SUZHEUI-PIEMPHASIS · 40 SEATS)

• Path B (Manual Component Copy-Paste + Human Visual QA Loops): $890.00 tokens + $1,550.00 labor (15.5h) = $2,440.00 / mo
• Path C (ADP v2.1.1 + suzhe-ui + designloop + pi-emphasis): $85.00 tokens + $270.00 labor (2.7h) = $355.00 / mo (-$5,425.00/mo · -93.86%)
